rubric.definition: Programs, targets, or allocations addressing women and girls. Includes maternal healthcare, girls schooling stipends, female teachers/LHVs, women councilor quotas, gender-segregated transport (Pink Buses), and women empowerment centers.

Initiatives specifically targeting vulnerable age cohorts: infants and young children (immunization, neo-natal care, malnutrition), youth (skills challenge programs, higher education vouchers, startup funds), and senior citizens (geriatric care, pension protection).

Interventions addressing historical regional deficits, backwardness, or marginalized geographies: specifically Newly Merged Areas (ex-FATA, Demand 60/61, AIP grants) and remote backward districts (Torghar, Kohistan, Upper Chitral).

Allocations and policies safeguarding religious minority communities (Christians, Sikhs, Hindus): minority welfare grants, security/repair of minority places of worship, scholarships for non-Muslim students, Auqaf allocations.

Targeted support for persons with disabilities (PWDs): special education institutions, accessible public infrastructure/transport, assistive devices, rehabilitation centers, and disability employment quotas.
Preservation and promotion of cultural heritage of indigenous or marginalized groups: museum construction, folk heritage preservation, community cultural endowment funds.
